visibleTestCases.title: Priority Drain (Urgent Ahead of Normal)
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin self() ! {normal, 1}, self() ! {urgent, 99}, self() ! {normal, 2}, priority_mailbox:receive_urgent_first(3) end
visibleTestCases.explanation: Urgent message 99 is extracted ahead of normal messages 1 and 2.

visibleTestCases.title: Client Request Timeout Fallback
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin Dummy = spawn(fun() -> receive after 500 -> ok end end), priority_mailbox:request_with_timeout(Dummy, ping, 40) end
visibleTestCases.explanation: Returns {error, timeout} within 40ms when querying a non-responsive worker.

visibleTestCases.title: Non-Blocking Mailbox Flush
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin self() ! a, self() ! b, self() ! c, priority_mailbox:flush_mailbox() end
visibleTestCases.explanation: Drains all pending messages in FIFO order using after 0.
